comments.author: Visitor
comments.body:
Hn. Poseidon is certainly more easily obtained, by comparison. But how do the two figureheads compare besides that?

Poseidon/Dragonhead Crisis Protection: 8/8. A tie.
Poseidon/Dragonhead Fatigue Relief: 2/7. Dragonhead wins this round.
Poseidon/Dragonhead Capture Sailors: 6/0. Poseidon is clearly superior here.
Poseidon/Dragonhead Cannon Evade: 0/0. Another tie.
Poseidon/Dragonhead Durability: 60/80. Dragonhead wins again.

Ignoring the FH Effects (another tie as far as I'm concerned), I would say Dragonhead appears to come out ahead as the narrow victor, due to its Crisis Protection being combined with Fatigue Relief, and higher durability. Poseidon is still a very good alternative, and its Capture Sailors stat gives it an edge in the event of melee battles, as well as how it can be produced via crafting.

That is just my own opinion, of course. Judge for yourselves what FH is best for your needs.
